service.description: Idempotent: the scrap account (519200000, a cost of goods sold child) on ORG_ZIZI_CORP's own AstTpInventory AssetTypeGlAccount rows, which ZIRET's postings reach through its rollup (impl-warehouse F40), so a Warehouse scrap posts apart from shrinkage. The rows are the ones init#PartyAccountingConfiguration copied, with sequenced ids, so a data file cannot name them. A row with a scrap account keeps it. Only data loading or a user with ACCOUNTING_ADMIN may run it.

Idempotent (impl-warehouse P14 review B2): the Warehouse returns demo's organization BOSS_WH_RETURNS (a child of ORG_ZIZI_RETAIL, so Retail's warehouse users work its returns at ZIRET_WH) settles its returns through Accounting (returnSettlementRequired, D11) on its own preference, set through Accounting's mantle.ledger.SetupServices.store#Preferences as finance administration sets it; Retail itself, on which Mantle's own return flows run, is unchanged. Only data loading or a user with ACCOUNTING_ADMIN may run it.

service-call.name: mantle.ledger.SetupServices.store#Preferences
